column1: # Security advisories reviewed for a pinned package version, read by scripts/release.sh.
# One entry per line, separated by tabs: GHSA id, the pinned version reviewed, why the release may go ahead.
# A new pinned version needs a new review and a new line.

column3: affects only .pkg and .mpkg package updates; Zack ships Zack.app in a ZIP, and the advisory names app bundle updates as not affected (reviewed 2026-11-21)
